name: OW Ventures
prepared_for: the OW Ventures and Olisipo Way team
facts: Includes Olisipo Way and M4 Ventures
position: OW Ventures is a CMVM-regulated Lisbon venture firm investing in startups with cutting-edge software, hardware and emerging tech. The group brings together Olisipo Way's pre-seed B2B focus on sales, marketing, adtech and productivity tools, M4 Ventures, the community-driven Angels Way fund and the COREangels Atlantic and SportsTech angel funds.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Olisipo Way's thesis, B2B tools for sales, marketing and adtech, is literally my CV, and your community includes companies like Leadzai, DOJO AI, Visor.ai and hAPI that sit right on top of what I've built.
summary: OW Ventures backs Portuguese founders very early, when the product is still being shaped and the first revenue engine doesn't exist yet. That's where a senior Product & RevOps operator changes the trajectory. I've spent nine years in tech building B2B and B2C products, from KYC and bot detection at 14M-user scale to ad tech and customer operations in New York. Your adtech, AI and identity companies match my experience directly, and I can work with them from Lisbon, freelance or full-time.

reasons.title: Sales, marketing and adtech tools
reasons.body: I've built for growth teams and been one: CS ops and reporting at Vibe.co, the start of Pi Network's ad network. That's Leadzai, DOJO AI and Brands&Ninjas.

reasons.title: Identity, onboarding and crypto
reasons.body: I owned KYC at Pi Network for 14M+ users. hAPI, CheckfirstAI, FLUXE, Talent Protocol and Lympid work on verification, fraud or onchain identity.

reasons.title: A fit for your community model
reasons.body: OW runs on community, from Angels Way to COREangels. I'm a Lisbon-based operator your founders can call on, for a sprint or for the long run.

vc_notes.thesis: Olisipo Way's B2B sales, marketing and adtech focus is my exact background.
vc_notes.stage: Pre-seed and seed: first product and first revenue engine.
vc_notes.platform: A community-driven model: Angels Way, COREangels and 50+ professionals.
